body:
• Ign: Immortal5
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: 1 year ago I was banned for advertising. I put in an appeal about 2 months ago and I was told I would be unbanned.... it never happened I got sad and I had to play on avicus. Im sorry for advertising and ban evading I will never do it again.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I should be unbanned because I have waited a very long time and I was told I would be unbanned but it never happened. I would also Love to record videos on this server.
  • I swear I will never break another rule ever again.
